address: calle Tiepolo, sestiere San Polo 1364, Venice, 30124, Italy
bio: Located in a 16th-century palazzo inside the Aman Venice hotel overlooking the Grand Canal, Arva is the ideal place to enjoy modern cuisine that celebrates sea, land and the best seasonal ingredients, purchased from the Rialto market and the islands of the Venetian lagoon. Not to be missed is the Benedetto Cavalieri spaghettone, garlic and oil, crusco bell pepper and scampi tartare....
